title: Store Closing Training Sign-Off Form
subtitle: A practical observed-practice training sign-off for store closing that connects identity, observations and evidence, decision authority, exception ownership, and accountable closeout.
description: An original retail-operations observed-practice training sign-off for store closing covering closing security and custody, evidence references, authorization, escalation, operating limits, disposition, and handoff without copying a third-party form.
use_case: Use when a closing lead opens one store closing record to plan instruction, observe practice, identify knowledge and authority limits, assign follow-up, and acknowledge the resulting work scope; closure requires a documented outcome, evidence route, responsible owner, and recipient acknowledgment.

sections.title: Closing training sign-off identity and routing
sections.guidance: Connect this training sign-off to one location, operating period, accountable owner, and review route.

blocks.label: Closing event scope, trigger, affected area, and prior handoff

fields.label: Store Closing scope and routing context

sections.title: Closing training plan and learner route
sections.guidance: Define the procedure revision, learning method, practice setting, supervisor, and authorized scope.

blocks.label: Closing competencies
items: Sequences customer cutoff and final transactions
Routes tender closure to the cash procedure
Performs a complete zone and occupancy sweep
Checks perishable and powered equipment status
Maintains key, door, and alarm custody
Recognizes conditions that stop departure
Avoids confrontation during unexpected activity
Assigns deferred work with owner and due point
Communicates limits to the next opening lead
Completes final departure and record retention

blocks.label: Training and authorization boundary
blocks.guidance: Do not leave a known access, alarm, occupancy, utility, or custody exception without an authorized owner and documented limit. Avoid confrontation and use approved emergency routes. Never record alarm codes, safe combinations, or reusable credentials here. Follow applicable closing, safety, privacy, and security policy and route judgment to the authorized reviewer. This sign-off records observed practice and assigned limits; it is not a license, professional certification, or guarantee of future performance.

sections.title: Closing coached practice and evidence
sections.guidance: Record the scenario, learner action, observable result, coaching, and next attempt rather than a generic pass mark.

blocks.label: Exception scenarios reviewed
items: Closing delayed by customer or transaction
Cash or controlled-item variance
Door, key, or alarm unable to secure
Utility or equipment cannot be left as planned
Staffing or departure safeguard unavailable
Final lockup or alarm release withheld

blocks.label: Strengths, repeated errors, prompts required, evidence references, and conditions for another observation

sections.title: Closing knowledge check, limits, and escalation
sections.guidance: Confirm that the learner can identify sources, stop conditions, authorization limits, escalation owners, and handoff evidence.

blocks.label: Condition and exception knowledge
items: Customer or visitor remains after cutoff
Cash, deposit, refund, or tender record unresolved
Door, lock, gate, key, or alarm exception
Equipment, refrigeration, water, or utility concern
Product, return, or delivery left unsecured
Cleaning, waste, or customer-area condition incomplete
Staff departure or transport concern
Required close task deferred

blocks.label: Knowledge gaps, restricted tasks, retraining topics, interim supervision, and evidence needed

fields.label: Store Closing knowledge gaps and limits

sections.title: Closing work authorization and follow-up plan
sections.guidance: Grant only the observed scope and state the supervision, expiry, reassessment, or restriction that applies.

blocks.label: Training authorization handoff
items: Readiness decision communicated to scheduler
Restricted tasks visible to supervising owner
Procedure version and practice evidence linked
Coach accepted follow-up responsibility
Reassessment date or trigger recorded
Learner can identify the escalation route

sections.title: Closing outcome, closeout, and handoff
sections.guidance: Make the final outcome, remaining limitation, next action, owner, and acceptance visible.

blocks.label: Closing closeout controls
items: Cash, deposits, and tenders handed to named custody
Keys and access devices transferred or secured
Unresolved equipment or facility issue routed
Deferred merchandising or cleaning task assigned
Next opening lead received operating limits
Final departure and store-secured status recorded

blocks.label: Outcome verification, recipient acceptance, and reopen decision
Unresolved work, customer or staff impact, evidence location, and handoff message

fields.label: Store Closing residual work and handoff

blocks.label: Training Sign-Off closeout acknowledgment
blocks.guidance: Acknowledgment records preparation and receipt; it is not a legal, safety, or professional certification.
